import json

# Category precedence inferred from the given correct examples (lower rank must come first).
RANK = {"opinion": 0, "purpose": 1, "size": 2, "color": 3, "age": 4,
        "shape": 5, "material": 6, "origin": 7}

CAT = {
    # opinion
    "nice": "opinion", "silly": "opinion", "terrible": "opinion", "good": "opinion",
    "awful": "opinion", "wonderful": "opinion", "lovely": "opinion",
    "obnoxious": "opinion", "ridiculous": "opinion", "repulsive": "opinion",
    "mysterious": "opinion",
    # purpose
    "typing": "purpose", "whittling": "purpose", "hiking": "purpose",
    "snorkeling": "purpose", "eating": "purpose", "drinking": "purpose",
    "driving": "purpose", "exercise": "purpose", "smoking": "purpose",
    "walking": "purpose",
    # size
    "big": "size", "little": "size", "small": "size", "tiny": "size", "large": "size",
    "huge": "size", "enormous": "size", "massive": "size", "medium-size": "size",
    "midsize": "size", "normal-size": "size",
    # color
    "gray": "color", "yellow": "color", "blue": "color", "violet": "color",
    "black": "color", "pink": "color", "green": "color", "brown": "color",
    "aqua": "color", "red": "color", "maroon": "color", "indigo": "color",
    # age
    "new": "age", "archaic": "age", "old": "age", "ancient": "age",
    "old-fashioned": "age", "brand-new": "age",
    # shape
    "rectangular": "shape", "square": "shape", "spherical": "shape",
    "prismlike": "shape", "circular": "shape",
    # material
    "wool": "material", "plastic": "material", "wood": "material", "steel": "material",
    "glass": "material", "paper": "material", "cloth": "material", "iron": "material",
    # origin
    "vietnamese": "origin", "turkish": "origin", "mexican": "origin",
    "filipino": "origin", "japanese": "origin", "american": "origin",
}

def classify(sentence):
    """Return (adjective, category) pairs; the first unclassified token is the head noun."""
    out = []
    for tok in sentence.split():
        if tok in CAT:
            out.append((tok, CAT[tok]))
        else:
            break
    return out

def is_ordered(pairs):
    for (_, c1), (_, c2) in zip(pairs, pairs[1:]):
        if RANK[c1] > RANK[c2]:
            return False
    return True

# Anchor examples taken from the givens, used to confirm the inferred precedence.
anchors = [
    "good gray archaic piano",
    "driving midsize rectangular toolbox",
    "ancient spherical fire extinguisher",
    "glass vietnamese drill",
    "steel turkish fire extinguisher",
    "lovely snorkeling banana",
    "huge green shoe",
    "midsize black pen",
]
anchors_ok = all(is_ordered(classify(s)) for s in anchors)

options = {
    "A": "nice typing big yellow new rectangular wool box",
    "B": "silly whittling little gray archaic square vietnamese bird",
    "C": "mexican medium-size violet ancient spherical typing silly bicycle",
    "D": "plastic large blue old-fashioned rectangular whittling good flower pot",
    "E": "wood turkish tiny pink archaic prismlike whittling ruler",
    "F": "silly hiking medium-size black old-fashioned spherical mexican steel necklace",
    "G": "terrible eating midsize green brand-new prismlike ruler",
    "H": "filipino paper small violet new spherical snorkeling lamp",
    "I": "snorkeling little brown old circular plastic american sunglasses",
    "J": "japanese glass midsize aqua brand-new spherical flower pot",
}

evidence = {}
correct = []
for letter in sorted(options):
    pairs = classify(options[letter])
    ok = is_ordered(pairs)
    evidence[letter] = {
        "categories": [c for _, c in pairs],
        "ordered": ok,
    }
    if ok:
        correct.append(letter)

if not anchors_ok:
    result = {"final_answer": "UNSUPPORTED",
              "evidence": {"reason": "inferred precedence contradicts anchor examples"}}
else:
    final = "".join(correct) if correct else "K"
    result = {"final_answer": final,
              "evidence": {"precedence": RANK,
                           "anchors_consistent": anchors_ok,
                           "options": evidence}}

print(json.dumps(result))
